blocks.text:
To: Barbara Hall
Cc: Jeffrey Ochoa, Megan Dudley

That answers it, thank you. The records with a termination date and no commencement are deferred benefits, so we will count them as your office does, and the member data for the Estes Group study is now closed on our end.

The next piece we need is on the financial side. To set the salary-increase experience against the assumption, Jeffrey Ochoa needs the pay records for the study period, and Megan Dudley needs the contribution and withdrawal detail to tie out the fund's cash flow. Whatever format your system exports is fine; we would rather reconcile from your native report than ask your staff to reshape it for us.

There is no rush on this before next week. Once it is in hand, we begin tabulating the {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}} experience and can give you a first read on where the current assumptions are holding and where they are not.
